ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Zekra needs access to your photos so you can add images to a note, or add photos and videos to a brain for it to read.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Zekra uses the camera so you can photograph a page or a whiteboard and add its text to a brain.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Zekra uses Face ID to unlock the app and to confirm it is you before revealing a vault secret.
